phase_1_encoding: That man's name was Elimelech.  And that man's wife's name was Naomi.  One son's name was Mahlon. And the other son's name was Kilion. Elimelech and Naomi were in Ephrah's family/clan.  That family was living in a town named Bethlehem [which was in Judah]. But that family went to a country named Moab. And that family lived in Moab.
